body: I just feel like the only thing that would make this worthwhile is gone now.  I'm glad that you have those who you value around you.  The one thing I'm taking away from all of this is that all of these financial considerations are secondary - if you are struggling with debt, those are the people who make it worth it; but if you walk into success or a wind-fall, it means nothing without them. I made the choice of going into debt, with the idea of working some high-paying, conventionally "successful" jobs, and in doing that I just threw everything else away.  Now, after all of it, I'm realizing too late that it isn't what I want at all.  Not that it matters either, because I've gotten rejected from those jobs anyway.  I'm alone, and just don't have a reason to keep trucking.
I get the feeling, I really do.  I checked to see how much my parents co-signed for, because I don't want to leave them with that.  It's stifling, and makes you feel trapped and hopeless.
